title: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) — Renewal Tenure Credit
content:
**Tenure credit on renewal.** The renewal tenure adjustment counts the renewal term premiums already booked on this policy: five or more earn a credit of 6 percent, two to four earn a credit of 3 percent, and fewer earn none.

A renewal term premium already booked is a term premium item booked on this Excess Flood policy's premium account on a renewal; the term premium of the first, new-business term is not one, and the renewal now being booked is not yet one.

| Renewal term premiums already booked | Adjustment entered (percent) |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | -6, a credit of 6 percent |
| 2, 3 or 4 | -3, a credit of 3 percent |
| 0 or 1 | none |

Every percentage selected for a renewal term is added into one net adjustment percentage, which acts once on the zone-factored layer charge after the elevation multiplier — that charge is multiplied by one plus the net adjustment percentage — and never on the loss-of-use charge.

**Boundary cases.** A policy with 4 renewal term premiums booked earns 3 percent on the renewal now being booked; with 5 it earns 6 percent. A policy with 1 earns nothing; with 2 it earns 3 percent.
